messages:
Sam: Noticed during the webinar promo that ~3% of HS leads stayed unassigned for >15m. Seems enrichment pend blocks RR fallback.
Neha: Can you paste a log sample?
Sam: 
[2026-01-22T14:12:01Z] intake: lead a1b2c3 created
[2026-01-22T14:12:04Z] enrich: webhook accepted 202 id=hook_x
[2026-01-22T14:28:30Z] assign: rr_wait blocking (enrich pending)
Luis: Looks like we never enforce a timeout. Assign checks enrich.score truthy only.
Erin: Proposal: add connector.enrich_timeout_seconds (default 300). If pending > timeout, assign to overflow pool and tag meta=enrich_deferred.
Sam: Need VIP bypass and outreach dedupe so we don't double-contact.
Neha: Telemetry: counter(enrich_deferred_assign), histogram(time_to_assign). Alert when enrich_deferred_assign > 0.5% daily inbound.
Luis: Canary: roll to 10% traffic for 24h with verbose logs and audit table, rollback if duplicate_outreach_rate > 0.2% or median TTF increases.
Erin: Playbook update: SDRs should see tag "enrich_deferred" and pause automated cadences until enrich completes. I'll draft.
leadflow-bot: rollout-ticket: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/leadflow/pulls/1901 -> staging -> canary-10% -> prod
Sam: Action items: Luis -> PR for logic, Neha -> metrics + alerts, Erin -> SDR note. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:
